BiblicalUsage: Rôʼshâh is how the Bible says the head. It stands in Zechariah 4:7: "…shall bring forth the headstone shoutings,, Grace, grace…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rôʼshâh is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
